delivered_in_window.description: Delivered orders in window (delay analysis base)

late_rate.description: Share of delivered orders that arrived after the promised date

median_days_early.description: Median days delivered BEFORE the promised date

funnel_happy_share.description: Share of placed orders delivered on time AND rated 4-5 stars

repeat_customer_share.description: Share of customers (in window) with 2+ orders

late_rate_seller_shipped_late.description: Late rate when seller handed over AFTER its shipping deadline

late_rate_seller_shipped_ontime.description: Late rate when seller met its shipping deadline

carrier_days_late.description: Mean carrier transit days, late orders

carrier_days_ontime.description: Mean carrier transit days, on-time orders

score_day0.description: Mean score, delivered ON the promised day

rd_jump_h3.description: RD level jump in stars at the promise (bandwidth 3 days)

rd_kink_h3.description: RD slope change: extra stars lost per day late (bandwidth 3)

density_log_jump.description: Log change in order density at the promise (negative = fewer orders just after)

rd_kink_donut.description: RD kink excluding days 0 and 1 (donut), bandwidth 6

pre_delivery_review_share_late.description: Share of late orders reviewed BEFORE the parcel arrived

timing_gap_stars.description: Mean star gap: post- vs pre-delivery reviews at the same days-late

comment_not_received_late.description: Share of late-order comments saying 'didn't receive / hasn't arrived / still not'

psm_matched_share.description: Share of late orders matched within caliper

effect_sellerFE.description: Effect of lateness on stars, within-seller (seller FE)

effect_aipw.description: Effect of lateness on stars, doubly-robust ATT

effect_psm.description: Effect of lateness on stars, propensity matching ATT

effect_one_star_pp.description: Effect of lateness on probability of a 1-star review (AIPW ATT)

effect_1day.description: Within-seller effect of being 1 day late (stars)

logrank_p.description: Log-rank test p-value, time-to-repeat late vs on-time

repeat180_ontime.description: 180-day repeat rate after an on-time first order

repeat180_late.description: 180-day repeat rate after a late first order

effect_repeat_pp.description: Doubly-robust effect of a late first order on 180-day repeat (proportion)

repeat_value_180.description: Mean GMV (R$) bought in 180 days by customers who came back

repeat_n_eligible.description: First-order customers with a full 180-day window

effect_ate_dr.description: Average effect of lateness over all orders (DR ATE), stars

worst_state_damage.description: Stars lost per 100 orders, worst state (AL)

auc_purchase.description: Out-of-time ROC-AUC, late-risk model at purchase

auc_handoff.description: Out-of-time ROC-AUC, model at carrier handoff

capture10_handoff.description: Share of late orders in top-10% riskiest (handoff model)

capture10_purchase.description: Share of late orders in top-10% riskiest (purchase model)

olist_mean_promise_test.description: Olist mean promised days, 2018 test orders

engine_promise_same_late.description: Engine mean promise at Olist's late rate (days)

engine_days_saved.description: Days shorter promise at the same late rate

engine_late_same_promise.description: Engine late rate at Olist's mean promise length

engine_late_at_18d.description: Engine late rate at an 18-day average promise

uniform_cut_late_at_18d.description: Late rate if Olist's promises were cut uniformly to an 18-day average

engine_q_match.description: Engine quantile used in monthly comparison

repeat_gmv_lost_low.description: Repeat GMV lost in 12 months, low case (R$)

repeat_gmv_lost_base.description: Repeat GMV lost in 12 months, base case (R$)

repeat_gmv_lost_high.description: Repeat GMV lost in 12 months, high case (R$)

late_gmv_L12.description: GMV on late orders, last 12 months (R$)

stars_lost_L12.description: Stars lost to lateness, last 12 months (base)

one_star_extra_L12.description: Extra 1-star reviews caused by lateness, last 12 months (base)

persist_seller.description: Correlation of 2017 vs 2018 late rate across sellers (≥20 orders each year)

persist_route.description: Same, across routes (≥50 orders each year)

route_capture_at10pct_orders.description: Late orders covered when routes touching 10% of orders are prioritised

top12_routes_late_share.description: Share of 2018 late orders on the 12 highest-priority routes

lever_A_late_avoided.description: Late orders avoided per year, lever A (base)

lever_A_stars.description: Stars protected per year, lever A (base)

lever_B_late_avoided.description: Late orders avoided per year, lever B (base)

lever_B_stars.description: Stars protected per year, lever B (base)

lever_C_late_avoided.description: Late orders avoided per year, lever C (base)

lever_C_stars.description: Stars protected per year, lever C (base)

pre_delivery_late_reviews_L12.description: Late orders reviewed before delivery, last 12 months
